narr: Stationary thunderstorms along the Bay Breeze resulted in localized rainfall amounts of two to four inches near Baltimore in an hour or two.
ev: North Point Road closed between Willow Road and German Hill Road for 6 inches or more of flowing water over the bridge at Bread and Cheese Creek.
